ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.5): Enugu Air Obtains Regulatory Approval for Direct Lagos–London Gatwick Flights Starting December 2026
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.4): State Commissioners Inspect Jimeta Ultra-Modern Stadium Progress & Energy Ministry Supervises TCN Corridor
GOMBE STATE (PSI 8.3): Farmers-Herders Dispute Committee Concludes Statewide Tour Enforcing Harvest Movement Restrictions
ONDO STATE (PSI 8.2): Gov. Aiyedatiwa Concludes European Agribusiness & Climate Investment Tour as State Launches Anthem CRBT Initiative
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.1): Plateau SAPIC & SPRiNG Programme Conduct Capacity Workshop on Women, Peace, and Security Framework
BENUE STATE (PSI 8.0): Gov. Alia Approves 10 Fresh Executive Appointments Across Youth, Revenue, Power, and Sanitation Sectors
KADUNA STATE (PSI 7.9): Deputy Governor Hadiza Balarabe Chairs November 2026 JAAC Plenary Session on Local Government Finances
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 7.8): Gov. Umo Eno Inspects Ibom International Hotel Project in Uyo & Highlights Job Creation Framework
OYO STATE (PSI 7.7): Oyo State Government Completes RAAMP Rural Market Infrastructure Reconstruction at Olorunda Akanran

CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.5): Cross River Assembly passed the 2027 Budget for 2nd reading allocating ₦708.43bn (71.72%) to capital projects; SSDC began a 100-room IDP facility and delivered fire trucks; sports ministry announced a $50k prize purse for the Governor's Golf Tour.

LAGOS (PSI 9.2): Lagos State urged Chinese firms at China Expo to build local assembly plants; Health District I launched a ₦1m innovation competition and explored AI electronic medical records integration.
EDO (PSI 9.1): Gov. Okpebholo signed an MoU with China Express for state airline 'Edo Air', became NDLEA Grand Patron, hosted annual development stakeholders, and validated health exemplar data.
ABIA (PSI 8.9): Gov. Alex Otti advocated for AI public revenue management at the Oxford Leadership Summit in Abuja and opened the 2nd Tertiary Sports Fiesta launching the Crusaders Club.
DELTA (PSI 8.8): Gov. Oborevwori performed the groundbreaking for Olam Agri’s $70m, 450,000-tonne animal feed mill facility in Ogwashi-Uku following summit commitments.
BAYELSA (PSI 8.7): BudgIT ranked Bayelsa top 3 in 2026 fiscal sustainability; Gov. Diri inspected Yenegwe Aquaculture Village facilities including 500 ponds and feed processing units.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.6): FG donated 5 tricycle ambulances for rural maternal transit; Gov. Dauda Lawal approved 75 merit-based technical recruits for the Zamfara Internal Revenue Service.
ENUGU (PSI 8.5): Enugu Air secured regulatory approval for direct Lagos–London Gatwick flights starting December 2026 in partnership with Omni-Blu Aviation.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.4): State ministerial team inspected Jimeta Stadium and flyover progress, while Energy Commissioner supervised the TCN transmission right-of-way to Madagali.
GOMBE (PSI 8.3): Gombe Dispute Committee concluded advocacy tours enforcing herder movement restrictions from October 2026 to January 2027 and banning night grazing.
ONDO (PSI 8.2): Gov. Aiyedatiwa engaged FAO-UN in Rome and Dutch coastal resilience experts in Amsterdam; state launched a public campaign promoting the Ondo State Anthem via CRBT (*309*2512#).
PLATEAU (PSI 8.1): Plateau SAPIC and UK SPRiNG Programme held a strategic capacity workshop in Jos to cost the Women, Peace, and Security plan and expand referral centers.
BENUE (PSI 8.0): Gov. Alia approved 10 fresh senior executive appointments across youth, revenue, power, and event management, charging appointees with blueprint compliance.
KADUNA (PSI 7.9): Deputy Gov. Hadiza Balarabe chaired the November 2026 JAAC meeting with 23 LG chairmen and state financial boards to oversee statutory funds.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 7.8): Gov. Umo Eno inspected the ongoing Ibom International Hotel project at Tropicana Uyo, emphasizing commercial real estate investments for youth jobs.
OYO (PSI 7.7): Oyo State Government completed and delivered the reconstructed Olorunda Aare Alasa Market in Akanran, Ona Ara LGA, under the RAAMP initiative.
